app.name: PipDock
app.tagline: A friendly dock for your Python environments.

env.partialListing: Packages installed for your user account are not shown here.
env.partialListingDetail: PipDock reads this environment in isolated mode, which skips {{path}}. Virtual environments are unaffected.
env.title: Environments
env.emptyHint: Install Python, or use Browse… to pick an interpreter.
env.managedDetail: Externally managed (PEP 668). Create a virtual environment instead; the override lives in Settings and is discouraged.
env.unusable: This interpreter could not be read.

badge.pinnedDetail: Pinned: left out of bulk updates. You can still update it on its own.
badge.heldDetail: Held at {{version}}: left out of bulk updates, and restated at this version in every plan.

packages.updateSelectedSoon: Previewing and applying updates arrives in a later version.
packages.emptyHint: This environment has nothing in it yet.
packages.noEnvironmentHint: Pick one on the Environments screen.
packages.outdatedFailed: Could not check for updates, so nothing is badged.
packages.orphanOutdated_one: {{count}} package has an update but is not in this listing.
packages.orphanOutdated_other: {{count}} packages have updates but are not in this listing.

plan.keepCompatibleImpossible: There is no compatible version to keep — this package can only be skipped or forced.
plan.forceWarning_one: Forcing this breaks {{names}}, which declared the constraint above.
plan.forceWarning_other: Forcing this breaks {{names}}, which declared the constraints above.
plan.emptyPreviewHint: The selected packages are already at the versions the resolver would choose.
plan.roundsExhausted: No decision rounds left. Confirm what is here, or go back and select less.
plan.cancelledDetail: You stopped this part-way. Packages already installed stayed installed, and one may have been left half-written — the snapshot below restores the environment exactly as it was.
plan.checkFailed_one: {{count}} dependency problem remains after this run.
plan.checkFailed_other: {{count}} dependency problems remain after this run.

uninstall.title: Remove packages
uninstall.body_one: This removes {{count}} package. A snapshot is taken first, so it can be undone.
uninstall.body_other: This removes {{count}} packages. A snapshot is taken first, so they can be undone.
uninstall.bodyBreaks_one: {{count}} installed package depends on what you are removing and would be left broken:
uninstall.bodyBreaks_other: {{count}} installed packages depend on what you are removing and would be left broken:
uninstall.rechecking: Checking what the wider set would break…

search.title: Search
search.indexMissing: The package index has not been downloaded yet.
search.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, or refresh the index if the package is new.
search.offlineDetail: No connection. Search still works from the local index; installing and metadata do not.

settings.title: Settings
settings.engineDetail: Which resolver PipDock drives. Both are supported; uv is faster, pip is always present.
settings.overrideDetail: PEP 668 marks some Pythons as managed by the operating system. Installing into one can break system tools, and there is no undo beyond a snapshot. Leave this off unless you know why you need it.

legal.title: Before you start
legal.intro: PipDock changes what is installed in your Python environments. Please read these before continuing:
legal.summary: PipDock is provided without warranty. It runs pip or uv against environments you choose, and every change is previewed and snapshotted first — but you remain responsible for what you install.
legal.accept: I have read and accept these documents.
legal.openFailed: Could not open the link. The documents are on GitHub under poli0981/pipdock.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.PD-ENV-001: That interpreter is missing or cannot be run.
errors.PD-ENV-002: This Python is managed by the operating system.
errors.PD-ENV-003: PipDock could not read this environment.
errors.PD-RES-003: A plan is already running. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
errors.PD-RES-004: Other installed packages depend on these, so nothing was removed.
errors.PD-SNP-001: The snapshot could not be written, so nothing was changed.
